'''''Parapholis''''' is a [[genus]] of [[Eurasia]]n and [[North Africa]]n [[flowering plants]] in the [[Poaceae|grass family]].<ref>Hubbard, Charles Edward 1946.  Blumea, Supplement 3: 14</ref><ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20110611161745/http://herbarium.usu.edu/webmanual/info2.asp?name=Parapholis&type=treatment Grass Manual Treatment]</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/floraspecie.php?genere=Parapholis|title=Genere Parapholis - Flora Italiana|website=luirig.altervista.org|language=it|access-date=2017-01-23}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.kew.org/data/grasses-db/www/gen00457.htm|title=RBG Kew: GrassBase - Parapholis Description|last=kh02kg|website=www.kew.org|language=en-GB|access-date=2017-01-23}}</ref><ref>[http://ucjeps.berkeley.edu/cgi-bin/get_JM_treatment.pl?8738,9165 Jepson Manual Treatment]</ref>

==Species==
<ref name=k/>
*''[[Parapholis filiformis]]'' <small>(Roth) C.E.Hubb.</small> - from [[Madeira]] to [[Turkey]]
*''[[Parapholis gracilis]]'' <small>Bor</small> - [[Caucasus]], [[Iraq]], [[Iran]], [[Jordan]], and [[Israel]].
*''[[Parapholis incurva]]'' <small>([[Carl Linnaeus|L.]]) C.E.Hubb.</small> - from [[England]] + [[Canary Islands]] to [[Tajikistan]]; naturalised in [[Australia]], [[New Zealand]], scattered sites in [[North America|North]] + [[South America]]
*''[[Parapholis marginata]]'' <small>Runemark</small> - from [[Morocco]] + [[Balearic Islands]] to [[Turkey]]
*''[[Parapholis pycnantha]]'' <small>(Hack.) C.E.Hubb.</small> - from [[Canary Islands]] to [[Turkey]]
*''[[Parapholis strigosa]]'' <small>(Dumort.) C.E.Hubb.</small> - from [[Ireland]] + [[Denmark]] to [[Libya]]
